speeeh bubble & dialogs should be above all else --- zindex issue

I’ll trace the dialog and speech-bubble stacking rules, then make the smallest z-index fix and verify the affected UI behavior. I’m using the repo’s `using-entire` workflow because this is a codebase exploration task and it can surface the original intent behind the layering.

Not absolutely everything—good catch.

- Interactive speech-bubble dialogs are at `20002`, above HUD, health, top-left controls, overlays, sleep popup, and spirit-pointer UI.
- Full dialog overlays are above health/top-left UI, but pinned slots (`1402`) and some tooltips (`1400`) could still beat the dialog panel inside the shared UI root.
- Lightweight world-space speech bubbles are canvas-rendered, so they remain underneath all DOM UI.

So the strict “dialogs and every speech bubble above everything” requirement is not fully satisfied yet.

I’ll close all three gaps: interactive bubble dialogs, full overlay dialogs, and the canvas-rendered lightweight speech bubbles. The last category needs its own topmost presentation layer—raising the game canvas itself would also cover the HUD, so a numeric bump alone cannot satisfy “above everything.” I’m using the repo’s history-aware exploration workflow to preserve the existing render/runtime boundaries.
